evidence.title: FIA launches Oscar Piastri investigation after Italian GP incident
evidence.body: [e002:f01] The incident in question took place during the Q2 segment of qualifying at Monza. [e002:f02] Oscar Piastri under FIA investigation over Liam Lawson incident at Monza Lawson was one of three drivers, alongside championship leader Kimi Antonelli and Williams’ Alex Albon, who went into qualifying knowing they faced a back-of-the-grid start due to engine penalties. [e002:f03] As Lawson embarked on his final Q2 lap, chasing a spot in the final stage of qualifying, he encountered Piastri’s slow-moving McLaren at the opening chicane. [e002:f04] Latest Italian GP talking points from FIA makes decision on Lewis Hamilton, Max Verstappen Italian GP incident FIA confirms Cadillac punishment after Colton Herta investigation It was an unwelcome obstacle quickly cleared by Lawson, though he would fail to make Q3 with that lap. [e002:f05] It was upgraded to a post-qualifying impeding investigation. [e002:f06] Piastri and Lawson, along with team representatives of McLaren and Red Bull, were required to report to the stewards at 17:40 local time in Italy. [e002:f07] Piastri was at the head of the queue for the all-important final Q3 runs. [e002:f08] He missed the Turn 1/2 chicane for the second time in qualifying, just as it was confirmed that he would be investigated after qualifying for that potential Lawson impede. [e002:f09] The end result of Italian Grand Prix qualifying was a shock pole position for Alpine’s Pierre Gasly. [e002:f10] He will be joined on the front row by Mercedes’ George Russell. [e002:f11] As it stands, Piastri is set to head the second row, with Ferrari’s Charles Leclerc for company, subject to the verdict reached by the FIA stewards. [e002:f12] Norris is due to start P8 only at Monza, which would give Piastri an opportunity to begin turning the tide, if he holds on to his P3 grid slot. evidence.title: George Russell tops Italian GP FP2 as FIA launches Lance Stroll investigation
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Championship leader Kimi Antonelli rounded out the top three on Friday at Monza. [e003:f02] Meanwhile, Aston Martin’s Lance Stroll attracted the attention of the FIA stewards, following an incident branded “dangerous” by Lando Norris. [e003:f03] George Russell tops Italian GP FP2 from Charles Leclerc The combination of Ferrari and medium tyres set the pace in FP1, Charles Leclerc ahead of Lewis Hamilton. [e003:f04] Sporting an upgraded engine and a Michael Schumacher tribute livery, it was an impressive start to the race weekend for Ferrari’s SF-26. [e003:f05] Antonelli’s 1:23.417 on the hard tyre served as the early benchmark for the pack to chase. [e003:f06] Lando Norris was forced into some major evasive action into the opening chicane, onto the grass and across, as he encountered a slow-moving Lance Stroll in the Aston Martin. [e003:f07] It was upgraded to a post-session investigation. [e003:f08] Russell elevated the leading pace to a 1:23.202, still on hard rubber, as the session ticked towards its halfway mark. [e003:f09] A 1:22.700 was delivered by the championship leader. [e003:f10] Russell readied his response amid a lull in the Monza action. [e003:f11] By 0.014s, Russell went top. [e003:f12] Latest Italian GP talking points via Flavio Briatore makes shocking McLaren accusation after Gasly FIA decision Why Pierre Gasly lost his Monaco podium after the FIA court ruling The track was now packed with cars on red-walled softs, as the qualifying sim stage of FP2 burst into life. [e003:f13] Leclerc slotted his Ferrari into second, 0.12s off the pace. [e003:f14] Russell had a vibrating front suspension under braking. [e003:f15] Russell ended FP2 on top, as Leclerc and Antonelli completed the top three. evidence.title: 'Brilliant' new Red Bull signing is 'massive mistake for Aston Martin' claims F1 expert
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Earlier this week the news broke that Tom McCullough is indeed leaving the team in green to join Red Bull from 2027 as their Head of Racing. [e004:f02] That means the 50-year-old Englishman will take on at least part of the role currently occupied by Lambiase in Milton Keynes. [e004:f03] It is expected that Tom Hart will replace Lambiase as Max Verstappen 's race engineer. [e004:f04] Article continues under video With 'GP' already confirmed to be leaving for McLaren not later than 2028, signing McCullough is the latest step in an important rebuild for Red Bull. [e004:f05] In the last 24 months the team have lost a glut of experienced top-level F1 talent - including Christian Horner, Adrian Newey, Helmut Marko, Jonathan Wheatley, Rob Marshall and of course now Lambiase. [e004:f06] Things are now starting to look again from a recruitment perspective with Verstappen having just signed a record-setting contract extension through 2030. [e004:f07] F1 HEADLINES: Lewis Hamilton stuns at Monza as Leclerc confirms Ferrari exit talks McCullough signing a 'brilliant' move for Red Bull - Windsor Former F1 team manager turned analyst/expert Peter Windsor believes McCullough is a terrific get for Laurent Mekies and co, but not so good for the team he is leaving - Aston Martin. [e004:f08] Speaking on YouTube , he said: "I hear that Tom McCullough is going to Red Bull. [e004:f09] He's worked for quite a few teams over the years - Williams, Sauber, Force India, more recently Aston Martin. [e004:f10] "And when he was moved sideways at Aston I did say what a massive mistake this was. [e004:f11] Very talented engineer, great guy, great feel for racing, real Rob Marshall sort of guy. [e004:f12] And brilliant to see that he's now going to Red Bull. [e004:f13] And what a mistake by Aston Martin to let him go. [e004:f14] "Congratulations to Tom, he'll do a great job there - it's probably the reason Max stayed, not the only reason of course but definitely a major step in the right direction for Red Bull." Red Bull rebuilding again around Verstappen Windsor appeared to be half-joking with that first Verstappen comment, but signings like this will clearly only have bolstered the Dutchman's belief that Red Bull can again surround him with the team to produce a championship-winning car. [e004:f15] So far 2026 has not been good for the once-dominant team, with Verstappen only sixth in the Drivers' standings while Red Bull are a very distant fourth in the Constructors' table . evidence.title: FIA announce 30-place grid penalty for Kimi Antonelli at Italian Grand Prix
evidence.body: [e006:f01] Antonelli will be joined at the back by Alex Albon – the Williams driver in more familiar territory than his Mercedes counterpart – after the latter was handed a 20-place penalty of his own for similar reasons. [e006:f02] Article continues under video Albon's penalty is ten places lighter as, while both took a fifth engine (ICE) and fourth control electronics unit (PU-CE), Antonelli also took a fourth energy store (ES) – with each carrying a ten-place penalty. [e006:f03] In an unrelated penalty, Mercedes will pay a €100 fine after Antonelli was caught breaking the pitlane speed limit by 0.1kmh in free practice. [e006:f04] The decision document released by the FIA read of Antonelli's punishment: "The penalty is imposed in accordance with Article B8.2.8 of the FIA F1 Regulations. [e006:f05] "The use of each additional element in this case carries a 10 grid place penalty therefore there is an accumulation of 30 places. [e006:f06] "Subject to Car 12 being classified in the results of Qualifying, Car 12 will be allocated a grid position in the race in accordance with Article of the FIA F1 Regulations." Antonelli: Monza offers many options Antonelli was asked after Friday's practice running what he expects when trying to cut through the field from the back of the grid on Sunday, and revealed that his long practice runs gave him something of an idea of how other teams may be using their battery deployment. [e006:f07] "Yeah, I mean it's a track where you can really do so many different things and you know it was interesting in the long run today running behind other cars to see what they were doing differently, where they were deploying compared to us," he told Sky Sports.

evidence.title: FIAは2027年から2029年までの期間を対象としたフォーミュラ2の新バージョンを発表した。
evidence.body: [e007:f01] マチュー・シャンブノワ 05年09月2026日12時44分に公開 09年05月2026日 14:44に更新されました コメント ©フォーミュラ2 2023年に行われた最終変更を経て、フォーミュラ2は今週土曜日、2027年から施行されるシングルシーターの新バージョンを発表した。 [e007:f02] イタリアのモンツァで今週土曜日の朝、プロモーターと フォーミュラ2のリーダーたちがまさにそう願っている。 [e007:f03] 今週末にF2と F3 も開催されるイタリアグランプリの傍らで、フォーミュラ2は2027年の次シーズン開始時にコースに登場する新しい シングルシーター の概要を発表した。 [e007:f04] 実際には、このマシンは2026年シーズンから使用されているダラーラ製シャシーをそのまま使用する。 [e007:f05] しかし、より接近したレース展開とマシン同士の接近を可能にするため、いくつかの空力要素が見直されている。 [e007:f06] 具体的には、3,4リッターモデルとなる。 [e007:f07] 2027年のフォーミュラ2マシンは、空力性能の最適化に加え、オンボードスターターを搭載する。 [e007:f08] しかしながら、2027年型F2マシンは、ブレーキ性能、ステアリング操作力、コックピットの人間工学に関する2024年型FIA規格を維持しており、幅広いドライバーにとって扱いやすいマシンであり続けることを保証している。 [e007:f09] F1のCEOであるステファノ・ドメニカリ氏は、若手ドライバーをモータースポーツの最高峰へと導くための準備を整えることを目的とした新型車の導入を歓迎した。 [e007:f10] 「この新型車は、革新性、安全性、そしてより競争力のあるレースを融合させ、ドライバーが才能を発揮できる公平な競技環境を確保するという、また新たな重要な一歩となるものです。 [e007:f11] 」 F2およびF3部門責任者のブルーノ・ミシェル氏も、この開発段階について詳細を語った。 [e007:f12] 「この新型車の設計において、我々の最優先目標は、ドライバーをF1へと育成するための理想的なツールであり続けることでした。 [e007:f13] これにより、コストを抑え、F1マシンに近づける外観を実現し、F2マシンの接戦性能を向上させることができました。 [e007:f14] 2027年初頭には、2つ目のキットが各チームに納入される予定だが、翌年3月に予定されているシーズン開幕までに、各チームが車両への理解を深めるための時間はほとんど残されていない。 [e007:f15] この記事はあなたにとって興味深いかもしれません 2式 04/09/2026 15:30 モンツァ – 予選：波乱のセッション終盤、カマラがポールポジションを獲得 この記事にコメントする 編集チームは提案する 式E 05/09/2026 21:06 ビクター・マルティンスは、日産がフォーミュラEで彼と契約しなかったことに「非常に失望している」と述べた。 [e007:f16] 平等に読む 2式 05/09/2026 15:02 モンツァ – スプリント：デュルクセンが逆転勝利、ツォロフの好調ぶりでチャンピオンシップのリードを広げる 2式 03/09/2026 10:44 LN Fusion – ランド・ノリスが自身のチームを立ち上げ、F1ピラミッドに大きな旋風を巻き起こす 2式 31/08/2026 11:46 7年前：優雅な銃士、アントワーヌ・ユベールの逝去 コメントを残します Annulerラréponse 購読者限定 今週の雑誌 今週号と過去の号をデジタル版で、またはご自宅でご覧ください！

evidence.title: FIA defends ‘legitimate’ process and hits back at Briatore: ‘No objection was raised’
evidence.body: [e002:f01] FIA Courts detailed how the judges were selected for the appeal over Pierre Gasly’s Monaco podium and said none of the parties raised objections during the hearing News summary The FIA said the appointment of the 4 judges who heard Red Bull and McLaren’s appeal was conducted according to its judicial procedures and international conflict-of-interest standards. [e002:f02] The federation said Alpine, McLaren and Red Bull were given opportunities to raise objections to the procedure or composition of the panel, but none did so during the hearing. [e002:f03] The statement comes after Flavio Briatore questioned the independence of 1 of the judges following the decision that reinstated Pierre Gasly’s 2 five-second penalties and returned the Monaco podium to Isack Hadjar. [e002:f04] A Federação Internacional de Automobilismo (FIA) se manifestou neste sábado (5) em resposta às acusações de Flavio Briatore de parcialidade no julgamento da Corte de Apelações que deu parecer faThe FIA responded on Saturday (5) to Flavio Briatore’s allegations of partiality following the decision by the FIA International Court of Appeal that reinstated Pierre Gasly’s penalties from the 2026 Monaco GP and returned third place to Isack Hadjar. [e002:f05] In a statement issued on behalf of the FIA Courts, the federation detailed the process used to appoint the judges and emphasized that the parties involved in the case had been given opportunities to raise concerns about both the procedure and the composition of the panel . [e002:f06] The FIA International Court of Appeal heard the case in Paris on August 25 and ultimately granted the appeals , reinstating Gasly’s original penalties. [e002:f07] “The FIA Courts wish to clarify that the appointment and participation of the judges in this case, as in any other, were conducted in accordance with the applicable FIA judicial procedures and usual practices inspired by the highest standards, such as the IBA Guidelines on Conflicts of Interest in International Arbitration,” the statement said. [e002:f08] All are subject to the independence and confidentiality requirements contained in the FIA Judicial and Disciplinary Rules, make annual declarations of interests to the FIA Compliance Officer and sign a specific declaration of independence for each individual case, taking into account the matter at stake and the parties involved, which is communicated to the parties,” the statement continued. [e002:f09] Flavio Briatore questioned the FIA’s handling of the appeal that stripped Pierre Gasly of his Monaco podium (Photo: Alpine) The FIA then directly addressed one of the central points raised by Briatore: whether the teams involved had been given the opportunity to object to the panel. [e002:f10] “ Both at the beginning and at the conclusion of the hearing, the parties were invited to raise any issue concerning the proceedings or the composition of the Court. [e002:f11] No objection was raised during the hearing concerning the manner in which the Court questioned the witness or conducted the proceedings.” The FIA also defended the diversity of the appeal panels, arguing that judges from different cultural and geographical backgrounds help strengthen the legitimacy of the process. [e002:f12] “A Court’s decision can leave room for various interpretations and comments as to its legal merits; that is fair and accepted by all judges. [e002:f13] The FIA Courts remain committed to the independence and impartiality of their judges and to the integrity of the judicial process,” the statement concluded. [e002:f14] The dispute over the judicial process, however, remains separate from the sporting outcome: the FIA says no party raised an objection to the composition of the panel during the hearing , while Briatore has publicly questioned the independence of 1 of its members. [e002:f15] The FIA has not confirmed Briatore’s allegations and instead defended the appointment process and integrity of its judges. [e002:f16] According to the FIA Courts, none of the parties raised an objection during the hearing concerning the composition of the panel or the way the proceedings were conducted.

evidence.title: SpaceXが史上最大のIPOを仕掛ける、AnthropicとOpenAIも上場へ突き進む
evidence.body: [e006:f01] 今週の大型上場が市場構造を一変させる兆候が見えています。 [e006:f02] 次世代の覇者が誰になるか注目が集まります。 [e006:f03] Techcrunch〜の発表によると テクノロジー業界には公開企業の新時代が形づくられつつある。 [e006:f04] SpaceXは今週金曜日に予定されている史上最高クラスのIPOに向けて準備を進め、Anthropicは上場計画の公募を控え、OpenAIは株式市場でのリーダーシップを巡る競争へと踏み出す。 [e006:f05] こうした動きは業界の力の均衡を根本から変える可能性を秘めている。 [e006:f06] もしすべてのIPOが計画通り進めば、それらはFacebook（現メタ）、Amazon、Apple、Netflix、Google（現アルファベット）からなる恐ろしいほどの FAANG結託を、新たなグループ「MANGOS」へと置き換えることになる。 [e006:f07] メタ、アンソロピック、エヌビディア、グーグル、オープンAI、スペースX。 [e006:f08] 新しいアクロニムは開発者の @krishdotdev 氏と @lilscoot 氏が X 上で提案したもので、すでに人気を集めている。 [e006:f09] FAANGは完全に姿を消すことはない。 [e006:f10] MANGOSの時代が到来する――新しい技術リーダーのリーグが、健全な経済と雇用を守る責任ある自律型AIの発展を支えることを期待している。 [e006:f11] 役立つ読み物： イーロン・マスクが主導するSpaceXの約750億ドル規模のIPOが始動。 [e006:f12] 価格固定や小口投資家配分など独自ルールが市場構造と投資行動に与える影響を解説します。 [e006:f13] OpenAIが米国での上場を検討、資金調達やガバナンス変化が業界に与える影響と投資家の懸念を解説します。 [e006:f14] 中東緊張とテクノロジー株の利食いで市場が動揺、円介入が日本に与える影響と今後の投資リスクを簡潔に解説します。

evidence.title: SpaceXのIPO需要が高まりウォンが急落、韓国当局が検査を強化へ
evidence.body: [e005:f01] 大口のドル需要が短期的に相場を揺さぶり、ウォンは一時17年ぶりの安値圏まで下落しました。 [e005:f02] 規制当局は追加対策を示唆しています。 [e005:f03] Reuters〜の説明によると ソウル発 – 最近、スペースXのIPOに関連するドル需要への大きな関心が韓国ウォンを圧迫していたが、内部市場関係者の話によれば市場から退いた。 [e005:f04] 推計では、ドルの購入申請総額は約15億ドルに達し、最終段階に入ったと、名前を伏せたいとする関係者が語った。 [e005:f05] スペースXは、同社史上最大級となる可能性のある投資家需要として、約2500億ドルを超える資金を集めた。 [e005:f06] ウォンはこのニュースを受けて再び軟化し、日中は1ドル＝1,524.1ウォン前後で推移、前日比0.56%高となった。 [e005:f07] 「スペースXのIPOによるドル需要がドル-ウォン市場にもたらす需要の規模には大きな関心があった。 [e005:f08] 総額はおよそ12億〜15億ドルだった。 [e005:f09] 」 – 関係者 市場の反応と規制当局の対応 ドル需要の高まりを受け、ウォンは先週、17年ぶりの安値を記録した。 [e005:f10] 国内機関投資家や富裕層の個人投資家が、宇宙開発大手スペースXのIPOの先行割り当てに参加する資金を確保しようと資金調達を試みたためだ。 [e005:f11] 推定される資本流出は約15億ドルでウォンを圧迫した。 [e005:f12] 2026年もウォンはアジア主要通貨の中で最も弱い部類の一つであり、ドルに対して約5%下落している。 [e005:f13] 韓国銀行と金融監督院は、相場操作を排除する目的で、14年ぶりとなる主要な外貨銀行への共同監査を開始する。 [e005:f14] エコノミストは状況は依然として動的だと指摘する一方で、規制当局のこの措置は市場の安定化と韓国ウォンの金融リスクの低減に寄与するとみられる。 [e005:f15] 他のニュースもお見逃しなく： ミシシッピ州の住民がxAIとSpaceXを相手取り、データセンターの騒音が健康被害や住宅価値の下落を招いたとして連邦裁判所に集団訴訟を提起しました。 [e005:f16] 今週の物価指標と大型IPOが相場の行方を左右します。

From SpaceX to Games Workshop: Where Monks Investment Trust Is Finding Growth
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Growth investing has become increasingly associated with a small group of US technology giants but the managers of the £2.5bn Monks Investment Trust [MNKS](https:// think that misses a much broader opportunity. [e001:f02] Monks does count Nvidia [NVDA](https:// among its top 10 holdings with a nearly 5% weighting, and Alphabet [GOOG](https:// at just under 4%. [e001:f03] It also has significant exposure to the semiconductor industry and has owned a stake in SpaceX [SPCX](https:// since before the company went public. [e001:f04] But elsewhere in the portfolio sit companies as varied as Games Workshop [GAW](https:// Japanese pharmaceutical group Chugai [4519](https:// and US firm Samsara [IOT](https:// which provides technology for companies operating vehicle fleets and other physical assets. [e001:f05] This range reflects the Baillie Gifford-managed trust’s deliberately broad definition of growth—and the management team’s belief that today’s increasingly concentrated stock markets are not necessarily representative of where the best long-term opportunities lie. [e001:f06] “We’re hoping we have a diverse range of growth drivers, and we don’t think that is reflected in the index at the moment.” ## Performance of Monks Investment Trust The trust has posted a total return of around 8% in the year to date and 14.86% annualized over three years and 3.12% annualized over five and five years. [e001:f07] The investment trust’s performance is below the returns of the benchmark over these periods: The FTSE World index is around 15% higher in the year to date and 18.82% and 12.52% higher over three and five years on an annualized basis. [e001:f08] In 2026, the trust is in the top third of funds in its category, EAA CE Global Large-Cap Growth Equity, and in the top 20% of funds in this category over three years. [e001:f09] Over five years, the trust has beaten just 40% of similar funds in the category. ## Monks Investment Trust Top Stock Holdings * TSMC [2330](https:// * Nvidia [NVDA](https:// * Alphabet [GOOGL](https:// * Amazon [AMZN](https:// * SpaceX [SPCX](https:// ## Monk’s Investment Strategy Taylor, joined the management team in April, and runs it alongside Malcolm MacColl, who has been on the fund since 2015, and Helen Xiong, whose tenure began in 2024. [e001:f10] Monks divides its portfolio between three types of company—rapid growth, growth stalwarts and cyclical growth. [e001:f11] “But by combining the three different types of growth, you probably end up with a smoother ride.” Michael Born, analyst at Morningstar, says: “Like other strategies at Baillie Gifford, there is an unashamed focus on growth, but compared with others in the stable, the managers here have a more pragmatic and open-minded approach to growth, with more of an emphasis on valuation.” ## Different Avenues for Growth The team’s focus on different avenues for owning growth comes as global stock market returns have become increasingly concentrated. [e001:f12] One example is Samsara, which fell around 50% from its highs and which Monks subsequently added to its existing holdings. [e001:f13] “We just don’t think that’s right,” he says. ## Growth Without AI Among holdings with little connection to AI, Taylor points to Games Workshop, the UK company behind the Warhammer franchise, as one example. [e001:f14] Monks favors semiconductor equipment companies including Japan’s Disco [6146](https:// and LaserTec [6920](https:// where Taylor believes technical expertise and strong market positions could make them durable beneficiaries of rising investment in AI infrastructure. ## Why Monks Owns SpaceX At the more speculative end of Monks’ growth spectrum sits SpaceX, which the trust first backed as a private company. [e001:f15] Taylor thinks investors risk misunderstanding SpaceX if they value it primarily by forecasting the future profits of Starlink, its satellite broadband business. [e001:f16] “What you’re doing is taking a variable cost on Earth in the form of power, because it’s essentially free once you get up there because of the free solar energy you have, and you’re swapping it for a fixed cost in launch,” he says.

evidence.title: Starlink launches commercial internet services in Uganda
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Photo credit: Starlink SpaceX’s Starlink has officially launched its satellite internet service in Uganda, opening a new market for the company’s high-speed, low-latency broadband across the East African country. [e002:f02] Uganda subsequently confirmed the commencement of Starlink operations, marking the end of a lengthy regulatory process. [e002:f03] The launch follows an agreement signed between Starlink and the Uganda Communications Commission (UCC) in May 2026. [e002:f04] President Yoweri Museveni witnessed the signing of the memorandum of understanding and five-year operational licence agreement at State House in Entebbe. [e002:f05] The agreement formally cleared the way for Starlink to establish operations in the country. [e002:f06] Under the licensing framework, Starlink is required to establish a national gateway and physical point of presence in Uganda, maintain a local operational office with technical and legal personnel, and ensure that devices activated in the country are registered. [e002:f07] The requirements are intended to strengthen regulatory oversight, security, revenue assurance and compliance with Uganda’s laws. [e002:f08] Starlink’s arrival comes after months of regulatory uncertainty. [e002:f09] In January, the UCC said Starlink did not yet have authorisation to provide direct-to-consumer services in Uganda, following reports that terminals were being imported, sold and used without a local licence. [e002:f10] The regulator said Starlink subsequently implemented geolocation measures to prevent unauthorised terminals from operating in the country. [e002:f11] The May agreement resolved the licensing dispute and established the regulatory conditions for Starlink’s commercial entry. [e002:f12] The service is entering a growing Ugandan internet market. [e002:f13] UCC data cited by local media shows the country had 19.7m active mobile internet subscriptions and around 20.5m smartphones by June 2026. [e002:f14] Data consumption reached approximately 267.4m GB during the second quarter, reflecting continued growth in demand for connectivity and digital services. [e002:f15] Starlink could be particularly relevant in locations where fibre networks and terrestrial infrastructure remain limited or expensive to deploy. [e002:f16] This could make Starlink less competitive with fibre services in urban areas where cheaper terrestrial broadband alternatives are already available.

evidence.title: SpaceX Dragon Leak Delays NASA’s Next Astronaut Launch
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Credit: NASA A leak in SpaceX’s Dragon propulsion system has delayed NASA’s Crew-13 launch while engineers work to clear the spacecraft for flight. [e003:f02] NASA and SpaceX are delaying the Crew-13 mission to the International Space Station after an oxidizer leak was found in the propulsion system of the Dragon spacecraft during routine prelaunch processing. [e003:f03] The leak was detected while teams were preparing the spacecraft for flight. [e003:f04] The SpaceX Crew-13 members pose for a portrait in their pressure suits during a preflight training session at the company’s headquarters in Hawthorne, California. [e003:f05] From left are, Roscosmos Sergey Teteryatnikov, NASA astronauts Jessica Watkins and Luke Delaney, and CSA (Canadian Space Agency) astronaut Joshua Kutryk. [e003:f06] Credit: SpaceX NASA and SpaceX Investigate Dragon Leak Engineers from NASA and SpaceX are now carrying out additional testing and reviewing spacecraft data to better understand the issue. [e003:f07] NASA has not yet announced a replacement launch date. [e003:f08] The four members of NASA’s SpaceX Crew-13 mission to the International Space Station display their mission plaque inside a training mockup of a space station module. [e003:f09] Credit: NASA/Morgan Gridley Four Astronauts Will Join Expedition 75 NASA astronaut Jessica Watkins will command Crew-13, while fellow NASA astronaut Luke Delaney will serve as pilot. [e003:f10] They will be joined by CSA (Canadian Space Agency) astronaut Joshua Kutryk and Roscosmos cosmonaut Sergey Teteryatnikov, who will serve as mission specialists. [e003:f11] Once the crew reaches the International Space Station, the four astronauts will become part of Expedition 75, the long-duration crew operating aboard the orbiting laboratory. [e003:f12] About two weeks before launch, the Crew-13 astronauts will enter quarantine at NASA’s Johnson Space Center in Houston. [e003:f13] Crew-13 Will Launch on Falcon 9 When the mission is cleared to proceed, Crew-13 will fly aboard a SpaceX Dragon spacecraft carried into orbit by a Falcon 9 rocket. [e003:f14] The mission will launch from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida. [e003:f15] NASA and SpaceX will announce a new launch date after testing, data reviews, and any necessary work on Dragon’s propulsion system are complete.
